scope: Narrow recheck of host-depth capture loops and the historical native artifact reference fence.

resolved_finding.previous: An absolute result artifact ref inside PROJECT could replace the native output prefix and reach a private file outside the declared corpus.
resolved_finding.evidence: The historical loop now invokes safe_relative(row['ref']) before path joining or capture. Absolute and traversal refs therefore fail before any referenced-file read. The remaining path is joined beneath the exact regex-validated native output root.

preserved_checks: Both capture functions retain approved PROJECT-root containment, per-component safety, bounded protected parent-and-leaf reads, commitment comparison and differing-recapture refusal.
Deep host ancestry is no longer interpreted as a cloud reference; the native artifact's own relative reference still receives its required reference validation.

Current retainer bytes are unchanged from the preceding review, including its source/package guard before tracked evidence writes. Historical PASS/FAIL attribution remains separate from full qualification credit.
limits: Static source-only repair recheck. No probe/test, retainer/publication, native process, qualification, generated/runtime evidence, private data, provider or network was executed or accessed. Root-reported sentinel probe results are separate evidence. No full retainer audit or product acceptance is issued.
